Troubleshooting · 40/50 · quality

QC severity classified incorrectly

Failure signal

A qc severity classified incorrectly condition is reported or detected during quality.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for quality does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Apply the same documented impact, visibility and deliverability criteria to the finding.

Corrective action

Reclassify with evidence, owner and disposition while preserving the original observation.

Prevention

Add this verification to the quality gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
